blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Alleiah Malaluan provided a much-needed spark for PLDT as the High Speed Hitters beat Creamline for their third straight win in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. Malaluan scored 10 points to lead PLDT’s second unit in handing the defending champion its first defeat, 25-19, 25-27, 25-23, 25-23, on Thursday night at Philsports Arena. “I feel like we’re calmer on the court now, especially after going through two losses. We definitely learned a lot from those experiences, and we always try to be good followers and good leaders for one another on the court,” said Malaluan in […]...
